    CSDC / CÉCD @ McGill University

    McGill Centre for the Study of Democratic Citizenship

    This is the McGill branch of the CSDC/CECD at Laval University. We study democratic citizenship, justice and political behaviors.
    More about our team, research and upcoming events below.

    Our Research View Upcoming Events See Recent News

    Our Research Focus

    At the CSDC, we work on:

    Learning Democratic Citizenship in an Unequal World

    • Social cohesion
    • Political socialization across generations
    • Support for democracy and democratic resilience
    • Immigration, integration, and belonging

    The Practice of Democratic Citizenship

    • Public opinion
    • Voting and turnout
    • Electoral behavior
    • Misinformation and fact-checking

    Citizen Representation and Governance

    • Political inequality
    • Parties and political competition
    • Democratic governance
    • Political institutions

    McGill CSDC

    The McGill chapter of the CSDC unites an interdisciplinary community to produce rigorous, mixed method research, train future scholars, and build public partnerships that strengthen democratic citizenship in Quebec, Canada, and beyond.
